metadata.description: Synthetic multi-domain health-tech, life sciences, and cloud platform enterprise organization.

repositories.name: sample-api-gateway
repositories.description: High-performance edge reverse proxy and authentication gateway routing traffic to core microservices.
repositories.readme_summary: Unified ingress proxy managing TLS termination, rate limiting, and route forwarding.

repositories.name: sample-auth-service
repositories.description: OAuth2 / OIDC identity provider, JWT token manager, and role-based access control (RBAC) security enforcement service.
repositories.readme_summary: Identity management microservice handling user sessions, multi-factor authentication, and JWT signing.

repositories.name: sample-patient-records
repositories.description: Electronic health record (EHR/EMR) service with HL7 FHIR interoperability, clinical notes, and HIPAA compliant patient store.
repositories.readme_summary: Core clinical repository for structured patient electronic health records and FHIR R4 API endpoints.

repositories.name: sample-telehealth-portal
repositories.description: Clinical patient and physician portal for telemedicine appointments, medical charts, and telehealth video consultations.
repositories.readme_summary: Next.js patient dashboard for scheduling telehealth visits and viewing clinical lab results.

repositories.name: sample-genomics-pipeline
repositories.description: High-throughput bioinformatics pipeline for DNA/RNA sequencing variant analysis and molecular genetics assays.
repositories.readme_summary: Distributed bioinformatics workflow for genome alignment, variant calling, and gene expression profiling.

repositories.name: sample-clinical-trials
repositories.description: Life sciences research platform for managing clinical trials, participant cohorts, biomarker datasets, and bio-specimens.
repositories.readme_summary: Study protocol tracker, participant randomization, and biomarker dataset analytics.

repositories.name: sample-billing-engine
repositories.description: Subscription lifecycle, usage meter aggregation, invoice generation, and Stripe payment webhook processing service.
repositories.readme_summary: Automated recurring billing, credit card payment processing, and usage-based invoice generation.

repositories.name: sample-ai-engine
repositories.description: LLM inference orchestrator, vector embeddings pipeline, and automated anomaly detection model.
repositories.readme_summary: Machine learning inference service powering semantic search and predictive health analytics.

repositories.name: sample-data-pipeline
repositories.description: Distributed real-time streaming pipeline and ETL workers aggregating telemetry events into data warehouse.
repositories.readme_summary: Streaming Kafka consumer workers ingesting real-time clinical and operational telemetry.

repositories.name: sample-user-service
repositories.description: User profiles, tenant management, and organization membership service.
repositories.readme_summary: Core tenant directory, user profile stores, and team organization hierarchies.

repositories.name: sample-notification-service
repositories.description: Multi-channel notification dispatcher for transactional email, SMS, and webhook alerts.
repositories.readme_summary: Asynchronous notification dispatcher handling email delivery and SMS alerts.

repositories.name: sample-python-sdk
repositories.description: Python SDK and CLI client for automation scripts, data science workloads, and backend integration.
repositories.readme_summary: Official Python library for querying the platform APIs and executing automation scripts.

repositories.name: sample-js-sdk
repositories.description: Official TypeScript and JavaScript client SDK for integrating with platform APIs.
repositories.readme_summary: Typed browser and Node.js SDK for API communication, token renewal, and real-time subscriptions.

repositories.name: sample-infrastructure
repositories.description: Terraform modules, Kubernetes Helm charts, and CI/CD pipelines deploying the entire platform to multi-region cloud.
repositories.readme_summary: Infrastructure-as-Code definitions for provisioning AWS EKS clusters, VPCs, and databases.

repositories.name: sample-common-lib
repositories.description: Shared Go and Python utilities, protocol buffer contracts, structured logging, and database helpers.
repositories.readme_summary: Base utility library defining protobuf messages, error standards, and telemetry hooks.

repositories.name: sample-architecture-docs
repositories.description: System architecture blueprints, technical RFCs, security whitepapers, and developer documentation.
repositories.readme_summary: Central architectural repository documenting domain boundaries, API contracts, and security models.
